## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes, and a test covers the change (a fixture for a script fix)
- [ ] The skill stays read-only: no step calls endpoints found in code, opens admin routes, uses keys or gets around limits
- [ ] No real company's findings, names, keys, tokens or personal data in examples, fixtures or tests
- [ ] New rules say how to check them, and new tells carry a level and a date
- [ ] README, CHANGELOG and the references are updated where the behaviour changed
- [ ] A change to SKILL.md rules was rerun on a blind-test target (`examples/blind-test`)
